international.title: ‘A new record for entertainment’: Grand Theft Auto VI sales hit $3.8bn on first day of release, developer says
international.summary: The announcement from Rockstar Games would mean GTA VI has already earned more than the entire box office run of the highest-grossing film of all time Grand Theft Auto VI generated $3.79bn in retail sales on its first day , publisher Rockstar Games has announced, calling it the biggest launch for any entertainment product in history. The worldwide figure was based on company estimates through the end of the day Thursday, the day the game launched. Rockstar said also it had sold 32.5m units of the game on prerelease, setting a record across platforms. Continue reading...
